newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria share index barely changes in mixed trade.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria share index barely changes in mixed trade.

text.p: Nigerian share prices were mixed on Wednesday as market players continued to anticipate the fiscal 1997 budget due to be released this weekend, dealers said.
The all-share index closed steady at 6997.83 on Wednesday from 6997.84 on Tuesday.
"Many dealers are being very cautious ahead of the budget," said one trader.
Oil shares continued to post the biggest gains with Unipetrol rising 38 kobo to top 60 naira a share.
Total, Mobil and Texaco gained 20 kobo each to close respectively at 58.40, 50.60 and 34.80.
Agip advanced 20 kobo to 23.53 while National Oil rose to 47.70, a gain of 13 kobo.
Top of the losers for the day was Nigeria Breweries, which fell 35 kobo to 18.00. NAL merchant bank lost 20 kobo to 4.60 while Guaranty Trust bank shed 10 kobo to 10.90.
Cement company shares performed badly, among them Benue Cement which lost 10 kobo to 7.00 naira.
Trading in the stock of British American Insurance Company was suspended at 1.68 naira a share on Wednesday following a query on its accounts by auditors, the stock exchange said.
